decisions.reason: Removing Aave yield does not remove the prize pools or the requirement to publish their values through public APIs.
Prize delivery directly to winners' wallets remains valid independently of whether prize-pool funds accrue Aave yield.
The removal concerns yield generation and does not alter Chainlink VRF, ticket-weighted selection, or on-chain verification.
The Big Block prize, draw trigger, funding sources, and ticket rules remain valid; only the redundant Aave yield integration is removed.
The Small Block prize, sales trigger, funding sources, and ticket-reset rules remain valid without Aave yield.
The FAQ state at this time does not advertise Aave or prize-pool yield, and its existing prize mechanics remain valid.
Allocation of tickets for no-referral mints is independent of the removed yield provider.
The automatic $5 referral commission does not depend on Aave prize-pool yield.
Referral-triggered Small and Big Block ticket issuance remains valid after removal of the separate Aave integration.
The mint price, founder share, referral commission, and allocation to active prize pools remain unchanged; the source only removes yield generation through Aave.
Separate Small and Big Block ticket counters and their reset behavior are unaffected by removal of the Aave yield integration.
